citation: Twentieth Report of the U.S. Civil Service Commission, fiscal year ending June 30, 1903 (Serial Set), pages printing the Civil Service Rules of March 20, 1903 (EO 209)
note: Official print of EO 209's opening clause ('in lieu of those promulgated May 6, 1896, and the amendments thereof') and its effective-date line ('to take effect on and after April 15, 1903'); the project holds EO 209 only as a Wikisource mirror transcription. Branches B01 and B13 rest on it. The PDF was fetched once by csc-annual-reports (REPORTS_FETCHED.csv, sha256 497139cc...) but only order slices were kept; keep the pages printing the rules.

citation: Thirteenth Report of the U.S. Civil Service Commission, fiscal year ending June 30, 1896 (Serial Set), pages printing the Civil Service Rules approved May 6, 1896 (EO 89)
note: Government print of EO 89's clause 'makes and promulgates the following rules and revokes all others' to back the Richardson compilation copy now held; branches B09, B12 and B12b rest on it.

citation: Fifty-sixth Report of the U.S. Civil Service Commission, fiscal year ending June 30, 1939 (Serial Set)
note: Corroboration that the restated Civil Service Rules (EO 7915) and Schedules A and B (EO 8043) took effect on February 1, 1939, with no postponement; the doctrine records that date as a disclosed candidate end for EO 209 (branch B02) and in the B14 gaps, and the report may also show whether the Commission treated the 1903 rules as ended.

citation: Twenty-first Report of the U.S. Civil Service Commission, fiscal year ending June 30, 1904 (Serial Set), p. 79 (EO 250, February 5, 1904)
note: Government print of EO 250 revoking the special rule of July 3, 1902 (EO 179); now held only as a Wikisource transcription. Exact Serial Set package id not found; the FY1904 report is missing from jobs/csc-annual-reports/output/REPORTS_FETCHED.csv. Branch B03 rests on it, and B07 uses it as evidence that special rules outlived the 1903 revision.
